asset.label: Vancouver/Richmond Health Board: red-and-purple logo with tagline, original vector
asset.sourceLocator: “Take Care: A handbook for families caring for older adults”, revised 2000 (back cover form HED2050 00/08), PDF page 1, the cover; the Internet Archive’s capture of 26 April 2003
asset.dateNote: The handbook says it was revised in 2000; its form code reads 00/08 and its PDF was made on 28 September 2000. The 2003 capture is when the archive kept it, not when the logo was adopted.
asset.notes: The board’s apple-heart emblem, a red heart in a purple dry-brush apple, beside “Vancouver/Richmond Health Board” in red serif and “Working Together for Better Health” in purple italic.
asset.fidelityNote: Original artwork: the cover’s own PDF drawing operations for the logo, isolated with their coordinates, curves and fills unchanged (no tracing, redrawing or font substitution; the lettering was already outlines). Rendered at 14×, the isolated PDF matches the cover to within antialiasing. The PDF download keeps the publication’s named inks, PANTONE 1797 CVC (red) and PANTONE 2627 CVC (purple); the SVG’s colours are RGB conversions of them, not a print standard. The dry-brush knockouts are white shapes, as printed, not holes.

asset.label: Vancouver/Richmond Health Board: one-colour purple logo, original vector
asset.sourceLocator: “Directional Plan: Working Together for Better Health 2000–2003”, PDF page 1, the cover’s upper left; the Internet Archive’s capture of 7 January 2004
asset.dateNote: The plan’s PDF was made on 29 February 2000 and modified in July 2001. The 2004 capture is when the archive kept it.
asset.notes: The same logo in one purple, with the heart left open so the page shows through, as on the cover of the 2000–2003 directional plan.
asset.fidelityNote: Original artwork: the plan cover’s own PDF drawing operations for the logo, isolated unchanged (no tracing or redrawing; the lettering was already outlines). The cover’s pale cream ground is not part of the logo and is left out. The purple is the cover’s process colour (C 83, M 100, Y 0, K 23), converted to RGB for the SVG.
